We Want A Chiefs Christmas
Original KC holiday album • Download free with every donation.

Why this album exists

Kansas City is stepping up with food drives, pantries, and mutual aid — but critical gaps are still being missed. Families are showing up to pickups to find expired cans, no dairy or meat, and nothing soft enough for neighbors without teeth.

  • Fresh food donations arriving spoiled or already out-of-date.
  • Pantries running low on kid-friendly snacks and school support items.
  • Homeless outreach teams struggling to find soft foods like yogurt and bananas.
  • Longtime distributors stretched past capacity just as need spikes.

How your donation works

Instead of guessing what people need, Rogue Round Table raises flexible funding that can fill the gaps in real time — and we give this album as our thank-you.

  • Cash only. Partners like Harvesters can stretch every dollar further than retail prices.
  • Funds stay in KC. Every donation supports local families across the metro.
  • Used for what’s missing right now: fresh foods, soft items, dairy + meat, kid snacks, pantry restock, micro-grants, and emergency family help.
  • You get the album free. Every donor receives a full digital download of We Want A Chiefs Christmas.
